What you may do with this pattern

- for the buyer's own use, and to teach from in a class where each participant has their own copy

- the pattern file, its charts and its photographs may not be shared, resold, uploaded or included in another publication
- questions are answered through the shop the pattern was bought from, against the exact version that was bought
- corrections and revisions are free forever, and buyers are told when the version they own changes
